items.title: John Altman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 14, 2023
items.q: I won’t name the wonderful tenor player that Jimmy named but I’m sure you can guess who it was, he said he used to borrow my horn

ctx.x: It would have found its way to a pawn shop, ey?

Yes exactly. And he said, I won’t name the wonderful tenor player that Jimmy named but I’m sure you can guess who it was, he said he used to borrow my horn, I used to go to the gig, stand at the side of the stage and walk home with him.
So you had a free ticket at a university yet if this is correct you gave it up to go with Hot Chocolate? Is that correct?
